description_expanded: Tucked away in the heart of Seagrove Beach , just 150 yards from the soft, white sands of the Gulf, Day Dreamer i nvites guests into a world where form meets fantasy. This modern four-bedroom, five-bathroom retreat sleeps up to twelve and was intentionally designed for those who appreciate the bold and beautiful — a true sanctuary for lovers of modern architecture, playful design, and luxe amenities. Framed by lush greenery and clean architectural lines, the private courtyard feels like your own secluded oasis. A shimmering private pool anchors the outdoor space, while a rooftop fire pit and cabana-style lounge offer endless opportunities to bask, sip, and unwind under sun or stars. Inside, the main living area unfolds with crisp modern lines and walls of glass that blur the boundary between indoors and out. Sunlight dances across polished floors, illuminating mid-century modern furnishings with a twist — sculptural chairs, bold pops of color, and iconic artwork that channels a gallery-like vibe with a playful pulse. The open-concept kitchen is a showstopper: crisp white tile, rich wood accents, and a waterfall island with bar seating for six. A long, contemporary dining table beckons for shared meals and conversations, while the adjacent lounge space invites cozy evenings by the large-screen TV. Just outside, the poolside cabana doubles as a second living area with wraparound seating, a wet bar, grill, and full bath — the ideal setup for al fresco entertaining. Each bedroom in Day Dreamer is a luxurious escape, anchored by king-sized beds, flat-screen TVs, and private en-suite baths. Two stylish guest suites on the first level offer privacy and comfort, while upstairs, the lavish Primary Suite impresses with a dramatic black-and-white bath, oversized soaking tub, and glass-walled spa shower. A second guest room includes a cozy bunk nook tucked behind sliding barn doors — perfect for kids or extra guests — and access to a breezy terrace. Whether you're gathering with family or friends, the smart layout gives everyone room to connect — and space to relax. Sip sunset cocktails on the balcony, or follow the spiral staircase to the rooftop sundeck. As twilight deepens and the sky blushes with stars, gather around the fire pit with wine in hand and the scent of sea air all around — a dreamy end to a perfect beach day. The sugar-white beach is just a 3-minute stroll away via Holly Beach Access, but Seagrove’s charm is just as close. Walk or bike to beloved cafes, Gulf-view restaurants, beach bars, and boutique shops. The picture-perfect town of Seaside is only minutes away, where art festivals, farmers markets, and live music light up the season. Modern. Memorable. Made for unwinding — Day Dreamer awaits. First Floor: Living Room, Dining, Kitchen, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Laundry. Second Floor: King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Garden Tub, King Bedroom with Two Twin Bunks, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower, Balcony Access. Third Floor: Rooftop Fire Pit. Outdoor Cabana: Kitchenette, Dining Area, Lounge, Full Bath with Walk-In Shower. *Add $75.00 per day to the heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
